PR07: preserve top-level SVG shared resources in every split layer

The committed-frame splitter only duplicated <defs>; top-level <style>,
linearGradient, pattern, clipPath, mask, filter, symbol, and marker
definitions stayed in the elements layer, so the frame-base document
lost styles and paint references. Treat every shared resource tag as
belonging to both rendered layers, and add rendered regressions for a
direct top-level style rule and paint server plus the clip/mask/filter/
pattern/symbol family.
